brief:
A new conviction has brought the number of Palestinians sentenced to life imprisonment in Israeli detention to 119, the Palestine Center for Prisoner Studies said. The center confirmed the figure following the latest life sentence handed down by occupation authorities.

The organization tracks sentencing of Palestinian prisoners held in Israeli facilities, monitoring cases involving convictions for charges ranging from security offenses to other crimes prosecuted under Israeli military law and civilian courts.

title: Palestine Center says new sentence raises lifetime prisoners to 119
